q: The non-wandering set Ω(T) of a diffeomorphism T consists of points x such that for every neighborhood U of x:
opts: T^n U ∩ U ≠ ∅ for some n > 0
The orbit of x is periodic
exp: Non-wandering: x ∈ Ω(T) iff every neighborhood U returns: ∃n > 0 with T^n(U)∩U ≠ ∅. Ω(T) is closed and T-invariant. For Axiom A systems, Ω(T) is hyperbolic and equals the closure of periodic orbits—the spectral decomposition theorem applies.
